description: Reg. § 1.469-1T(f)(2)(i)(D) Example 2: significant participation activities A (income 15,000 − 5,000 = 10,000) and B (5,000 − 10,000 = loss 5,000) net to $5,000 of income, which is nonpassive, so A and B are 'a single activity that does not have a loss'; C (loss 10,000) and D (income 2,000) are other passive activities. The passive activity loss is $8,000 ($43,000 − $35,000), all allocated to C: 'none of the $8,000 passive activity loss is allocated ... to activity B'.
